name: Site Alpha (binding cap)
notes: Site Alpha with the charger count a real 3 MW depot would carry. R-4 measures normal practice at ~2:1 to ~3.4:1 installed-nameplate to service-capacity; this profile sits at 2.50:1 (7,512 kW of chargers on a 3,000 kW service: 48x150 kW DCFC + 8x11 kW L2 + 6x4 kW AMR pad). Deliberate oversubscription at this ratio is standard for multi-charger depots and is only permitted BECAUSE certified load management exists -- which is what this kernel is. Here the cap actually binds, so a power-cap conformance result measures scheduling rather than arithmetic. This is the profile a credible throughput benchmark should run on; site_alpha is kept only to preserve the as-built defect.

tariff.notes: From the NES commercial-rate PDF, already held in ottoq_depot_tariffs. Demand basis is 30-minute NCP -- a Southeast regional trait (R-5), NOT a default. Energy rate 4.785 c/kWh is the base excluding the TVA fuel cost adjustment (~2.8-4 c/kWh), so total energy cost is understated here by design; the FCA is a pass-through that varies monthly.
